recommendation: Test one fixed ETH component-decay exit without changing live v58.
why_now: The current ETH lifecycle exceeded 300 bps MFE and then gave back profit while the canonical component bank opposed the long, whereas structural regime support remained positive.
evidence_reviewed: exact ETH native-12h and R-normalized historical replay
current protected v58 ETH open-path telemetry
rejected global regime-loss exit and prior structural support-decay studies
observed_problem_or_opportunity: Static profit locks degraded the exact ETH route, but a state-aware exit activated only after a large favorable excursion may distinguish failed continuation from ordinary noise.
applicable_market_regime: ETH pullback entries that first achieve at least 300 bps MFE and later develop persistent component opposition before the native 12-hour exit.
alternatives_considered: R2 and R5 static profit locks
expected_upside: Test whether large ETH winners can preserve more return without broadly clipping the route's continuation tails.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: The hypothesis is inspired by one open path, component direction had inverse later-window IC in prior attribution, OHLC replay cannot prove tick-exact trigger order, and the fixed threshold may still be overfit despite the no-grid design.
validation_completed: Input identities, exact route replay contract, causal component prefix invariance, native stop precedence, and prior rejected exit families were identified before candidate economics.
validation_still_required: Causal fixed-entry replay, complete component coverage, next-open execution, exact fees/funding/slippage, five development folds, opened-final confirmation, side attribution, drawdown, and largest-winner sensitivity.

success_metrics.technical: Zero unavailable component rows on every evaluated lifecycle path and exact control/candidate entry parity.
success_metrics.development: Candidate net and profit factor exceed native control, candidate net excluding its largest winner is positive, maximum drawdown does not worsen, and at least three of five chronological folds have positive candidate net and positive delta versus control.
success_metrics.opened_final_60d: Candidate net and profit factor exceed native control, candidate net excluding its largest winner is positive, maximum drawdown does not worsen, and both long and short candidate slices remain positive.
success_metrics.disposition: A full pass permits only a future frozen report-only observer proposal; any failed condition rejects the candidate for live use.

failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any missing component evidence, entry mismatch, causal-order violation, segment reversal, largest-winner dependence, side collapse, or drawdown degradation rejects the candidate. No live rollback applies because this experiment has no execution authority.
falsifier: Reject if the fixed candidate fails any declared technical or economic metric; update only with a source-bound implementation correction or a genuinely future frozen observer sample, not by retuning thresholds on these windows.
